title: 川普喊晶片回美國！台積電毛利率要被吃掉 4 個百分點，2027 再漲價？
summary:
台積電剛交出史上最賺的一季，毛利率 67.7%、稅後純益年增 77.4%，同一場法說會上財務長黃仁昭卻預告，海 […]

〈川普喊晶片回美國！台積電毛利率要被吃掉 4 個百分點，2027 再漲價？〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。
full_text:
台積電剛交出史上最賺的一季，毛利率 67.7%、稅後純益年增 77.4%，同一場法說會上財務長黃仁昭卻預告，海外晶圓廠陸續投產將在未來數年持續稀釋毛利率，初期約 2 到 3 個百分點，後期可能擴大到 3 到 4 個百分點。晨星估算，在美國生產的成本比台灣高出 20% 到 50%。
（前情提要：川普：美光在美國投資 2500 億鎂！這是我的「川普效應」能創造 10 萬職缺）
（背景補充：台經院喊今年 GDP 成長破 10%：AI 商機潮能撐到 2028 年）
重點摘要
- 台積電 Q2 毛利率 67.7% 創高，稅後純益年增 77.4% 至新台幣 7,066 億元
- 財務長黃仁昭預告海外廠稀釋毛利率初期 2-3 個百分點、後期擴大到 3-4 個百分點
- 晨星估美國生產成本高出台灣 20-50%，台積電計畫 2027 年調漲代工價 5-10%
台積電交出史上最賺的一季，法說會上，財務長暨發言人黃仁昭也把未來幾年的成本帳單攤開。據 CNBC 報導，川普政府推動先進晶片製造回流美國，海外產能擴張正在墊高台積電的生產成本，並將在未來數年持續拖累公司毛利率。
先看賺的部分，台積電 2026 年第二季合併營收約新台幣 1 兆 2,704 億元，年增 36%；稅後純益約新台幣 7,066 億元，每股純益 27.25 元，兩者年增幅都是 77.4%，雙雙改寫歷史紀錄。毛利率 67.7%，比第一季的 66.2% 再高出 1.5 個百分點，2 奈米製程本季也開始貢獻營收。
再看之後要付出的部分，黃仁昭在法說會上說明，海外晶圓廠陸續投產，未來數年初期將稀釋毛利率約 2 到 3 個百分點，後期可能擴大到 3 到 4 個百分點。台積電對第三季的毛利率指引已經下修到 65% 到 67% 區間。
2000 億美元的「政治帳單」
自川普 2025 年重返白宮以來，台積電對美投資承諾累計已達 2000 億美元，其中包括上週法說會同步公布的 1000 億美元先進半導體製造及先進封裝計畫。加計 CHIPS 法案時期的 650 億美元，台積電在美國的總投資額來到 2650 億美元，規劃 10 座晶圓廠與 2 座先進封裝廠。白宮把這筆錢直接列為川普貿易與產業政策推動的成果。
台積電同時把 2026 年資本支出上調至 600 億到 640 億美元，全年營收成長預估上修到 4 成以上。錢照砸，只是這輪砸的位置離台灣愈來愈遠。
多出來的成本最後誰付
晨星（Morningstar）資深股票分析師 Phelix Lee 估算，台積電在美國生產的晶片，成本會比台灣製造高出 20% 到 50%，實際數字取決於補貼撥款時點、稅收抵免的認列方式與其他成本波動。
台積電在美國生產的晶片成本，會比台灣製造高出 20% 到 50%，取決於補貼時點、稅收抵免認列與其他成本波動。（晨星資深股票分析師 Phelix Lee）
市場普遍預期台積電會把一部分成本轉給客戶，《日經亞洲》先前報導，台積電計畫從 2027 年初調漲晶圓代工價格，先進製程與成熟製程的基本漲幅落在 5% 到 10%，若客戶追加高效能運算（HPC）訂單超出原先預估需求，還要再加收 10% 到 15% 溢價，部分先進製程訂單的實際漲幅會超過 10%。
給客戶一年半調整預算與供應鏈，這是議價方有本錢才做得起的安排。
台灣專家看法
台經院產經資料庫總監劉佩真接受 《聯合報》 訪問時表示，這次加碼「並不令人意外」，「台積電原本就產能不足，既要符合美國在地製造，且要防範競爭對手搶單，加大對美投資符合台積電利益」。她也指出台灣的水電供給已接近極限，台積電勢必要在全球做產能槓桿。
劉佩真提醒，台積電「在台創造的就業及投資規模，可能會受影響」，並強調「台積電必須根留台灣，在台灣的先進製程與美國時間差至少兩年以上，才能確保台灣優勢與利益」。
微驅科技總經理吳金榮則對 《商業周刊》 分析，海外擴廠吃掉的毛利，換來的是跟客戶更深度的綁定，台積電從晶圓到 CoWoS 封裝的一條龍服務，「這種整合能力，短期內沒人能複製」。他同時點出 3 奈米製程良率趨穩、折舊壓力遞減，該節點毛利率下半年可望超越公司平均水準，正好補上海外廠咬掉的部分。
外資的定價也偏向這一邊，法說會後多家券商調升台積電目標價，最高喊到 4,200 元。至於台灣這邊真正要盯的指標，其實是劉佩真講的那個「兩年時間差」。美國 10 座廠蓋完是十年後的事，先進製程留在台灣的領先幅度還剩多少？明年的漲價只是一個過渡。
常見問題
台積電為什麼要去美國建廠？成本不是比較高嗎？
主因是川普政府推動先進晶片製造回流美國，加上客戶要求供應鏈分散風險。晨星估算美國生產成本比台灣高 20% 到 50%，但台積電對美投資已累計 2650 億美元，規劃 10 座晶圓廠與 2 座先進封裝廠。
台積電 2027 年漲價會漲多少？
根據《日經亞洲》報導，先進製程與成熟製程基本漲幅為 5% 到 10%，2027 年初生效。若客戶追加 HPC 訂單超出原估需求，還要再加收 10% 到 15% 溢價，部分先進製程訂單實際漲幅會超過 10%。

title: Andrej Karpathy 公開大神 Prompt 心法：開語音跟 AI 狂聊 10 分鐘
summary:
OpenAI 創始成員、現任 Anthropic 預訓練團隊成員 Andrej Karpathy 週二（7/2 […]

〈Andrej Karpathy 公開大神 Prompt 心法：開語音跟 AI 狂聊 10 分鐘〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。
full_text:
OpenAI 創始成員、現任 Anthropic 預訓練團隊成員 Andrej Karpathy 週二（7/21）在 X 上公開自己跟 LLM 協作的固定套路，遇到複雜任務時他不打字，直接切到語音輸入連講 10 分鐘，內容可以跳躍、混亂、毫無章法。他的觀察是模型很擅長從語無倫次的長篇裡還原你真正想做的事，吐回來的版本通常比你自己講的還乾淨。
（前情提要：OpenAI 創始成員 Andrej Karpathy 宣布加入 Anthropic：重返 LLM 研發最前線）
（背景補充：Andrej Karpathy 提煉「CLAUDE.md 四大準則」引爆 GitHub，讓 AI 寫 Code 準確率飆破 90%）
懶得打字，就用講的。Andrej Karpathy 週二（7/21）在 X 上寫下自己跟 LLM 協作的一個固定套路，需要交代的背景太多、手指卻跟不上腦袋的時候，他會往椅背一靠，切到 /voice 語音輸入，然後連續講 10 分鐘。「完全一團亂，什麼都可以講，全程意識流。」
One pattern I find useful for working with LLMs is a nice long ramble session. Sometimes the LLM needs more bits to understand what you're trying to achieve, but you're too lazy to type them. In these cases I like to lean back, switch to /voice and just ramble for like 10…
— Andrej Karpathy (@karpathy) July 21, 2026
有時候他會先跟模型打聲招呼，在開頭補一句「切換成語音辨識了，錯字先說聲抱歉」；有時候他乾脆把這段獨白變成一場小型訪談，讓模型反過來追問幾輪，把散落的線索一條一條挖出來。
語音輸入本身不是新東西，Karpathy 真正在講的是輸入量。與其花力氣把想法整理成一段乾淨的指令，不如把整包想法直接丟過去，讓模型自己拆開來重組。
前期多講一點，後面少改一點
他給的理由很直接。「LLM 不知為何非常擅長重建冗長而語無倫次的獨白，它們迴音給你的那份，往往比你原本那團思緒還乾淨得多。」他寫道，結果是 mind meld（心靈融合，指人跟模型對彼此意圖的理解逐漸對齊）改善了，從那個時間點之後，需要回頭糾正的地方反而更少。
這句話點出這套方法真正的成本結構。大部分人省了前期打字的力氣，代價是後面反覆修正、來回丟訊息澄清自己的意思；Karpathy 的做法是把成本全部押在前面那 10 分鐘，用一次超大量的背景資訊交代，換掉後面五輪的「不是這個意思」。
反對的人都擔心同一件事
X 回覆區大致分成兩派。支援的人說這套已經佔掉自己八成的 prompt，也有人形容改以語音為主之後產出效率翻了 5 到 8 倍，多語使用者則喜歡它不挑語言。
反對的聲音則集中在同一個顧慮，把「把話講清楚」這件事整個外包給模型，長期下來自己的組織能力跟寫作能力會不會退化。有人給出折衷做法，模型整理完之後自己再手動蒸餾一次，不要照單全收。
兩邊其實沒有誰對誰錯，Karpathy 的用法是把模型當成會整理的鏡子，不是代筆，差別只在你有沒有把它整理出來的版本讀回去。
用 6 個 Prompt 打造完整學習系統：學習階梯、20法則、費曼迴圈…
Claude 寫程式瘋狂犯錯裝傻？改造 Andrej Karpathy 的12 條規則幫你把錯誤率從 41% 砍到 3％

title: AI 燒錢今晚交卷：Alphabet 攤牌 1,900 億鎂資本支出，特斯拉迎來極大波動
summary:
Alphabet 與特斯拉將於臺灣時間 7 月 23 日凌晨、美股盤後同步公布 2026 年第二季財報，Int […]

〈AI 燒錢今晚交卷：Alphabet 攤牌 1,900 億鎂資本支出，特斯拉迎來極大波動〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。
full_text:
Alphabet 與特斯拉將於臺灣時間 7 月 23 日凌晨、美股盤後同步公布 2026 年第二季財報，Intel 緊接在隔天。選擇權市場已經先站好位置，押特斯拉財報後單日震盪 5.91%，換算約 830 億美元市值，是這家公司一年來最大的財報波動預期。市場真正要問的不是這兩家賺多少，而是今年砸下去的 7,000 億美元 AI 資本支出，到底換回了什麼。
（前情提要：Google 推出 Gemini 3.6 Flash 等三款新模型！3.5 Flash-Lite 飆出極速，Gemini 4 預訓練已啟動）
（背景補充：花旗喊「美股七巨頭已死」，改押注橫跨六大產業的成長型公司）
重點摘要
- 選擇權市場押特斯拉財報後震盪 5.91%，約 830 億美元市值懸在一線
- Alphabet 今年資本支出上看 1,900 億美元，Q1 自由現金流卻年減 47% 只剩 101 億
- 特斯拉 Q2 交車 480,126 輛創新高，市場只盯不含碳權的汽車毛利率守不守得住 18%
選擇權市場的定價已經把話說完了。Benzinga 統計，特斯拉財報前的隱含波動來到 5.91%，以 1.4 兆美元市值換算，等於有 830 億美元的市值押在今晚這份財報上，是本週所有公布財報的公司裡絕對金額第二大的一家。
CNBC 則指出，這是交易員一年來對特斯拉開出的最大財報波動預期，上一次押到 6% 已經是 2025 年 10 月的事。
Alphabet 這邊相對剋制，選擇權隱含約 5.4% 的單日移動，但它的市值是 4.3 兆美元，任何一個百分點都是好幾千億在跑。Intel 排在 7 月 23 日盤後，隱含波動高達 12%。三份財報擠在同一個禮拜，被分析師形容為 AI 支出週期至今最完整的單週檢驗點。
兩家公司進場的姿勢都不太好看，Alphabet 上週五收在 346.77 美元，距離今年 408.61 美元的高點回檔約 15%；特斯拉今年以來跌了 18%，是七巨頭裡表現最差的一個，離 52 週高點 498.83 美元還有約 25% 的距離。財報還沒開，股價已經先跌給你看。
Alphabet 的問題是錢花去哪
市場對 Alphabet 第二季的共識落在營收 1,136 億至 1,168 億美元之間（各家資料商口徑不同），每股盈餘 2.87 美元，去年同期是 964 億美元與 2.31 美元。這個成績單本身不難看。
難看的是現金流那一頁，Alphabet 上一季把全年資本支出指引拉高到 1,800 億至 1,900 億美元，還告訴投資人 2027 年會再往上跳一大階。第一季單季資本支出年增 107% 來到 357 億美元，同一時間自由現金流年減約 47%，只剩 101 億美元。花得比去年多一倍，手上剩的少一半，這個剪刀差就是今晚所有人要問的那一題。
支撐這筆錢的敘事是雲端，Google Cloud 第一季營收年增 63%，訂單積壓（backlog）單季幾乎翻倍到超過 4,600 億美元，市場預期第二季雲端營收再增約 65% 到 225 億美元，搜尋業務則約 632.9 億美元。積壓訂單是漂亮數字，但積壓不等於入帳，今晚要看的是這 4,600 億轉成營收的速度有沒有跟上折舊的速度。
另個問題插在 Gemini，Google 五月在 I/O 開發者大會上說 Gemini 3.5 Pro 六月上線，到七月中還是沒有出現。彭博報導指出，Google 為了拉高 Gemini 的程式碼能力更新了訓練資料，結果不如預期，而企業客戶最在意的就是這塊。
動區昨日才報導 Google 一口氣發布 Gemini 3.6 Flash 等三款模型、Gemini 4 也已進入預訓練。Flash 系列連發三款、旗艦 Pro 沒出，這本身就是回答。
分析師倒沒有集體轉空，Guggenheim 的 Michael Morris 維持買進、目標價 450 美元，直接把 Gemini 延遲視為「全端 AI 領導者的進場點」而不是基本面問題；BMO Capital 上調至 455 美元、KeyBanc 上調至 445 美元。但 UBS 把目標價下修到 400 美元、Wells Fargo 下修到 416 美元，多空的分歧點幾乎都落在同一句話：這 1,900 億買的是護城河，還是折舊。
特斯拉交車創新高
特斯拉第二季交付 480,126 輛，是公司史上最好的一季，數字七月初就已公布，問題是這件事沒有換來股價。
共識數字非常分歧，特斯拉七月十七日在投資人關係頁面公布自家彙編的分析師共識，營收 275.8 億美元、非美國通用會計準則每股盈餘 0.55 美元、美國通用會計準則每股盈餘 0.36 美元、淨利 15 億美元。但市場上流通的版本從 252.4 億到 264 億美元都有，每股盈餘 0.44 到 0.55 美元不等。同一家公司、同一季，賣方之間差出二十幾億美元的營收，這種分歧度本身就是波動的來源。
真正的戰場在毛利率，分析師預期不含碳權的汽車毛利率略高於 18%，這條線守不守得住，比多賣幾萬台車重要多了。現金部分同樣吃緊，市場預估特斯拉第二季的自由現金流為負 32.5 億美元，資本支出接近 67 億美元，錢都投去了 AI 基礎建設、產能擴張與 Robotaxi 部署。
交車創新高，特斯拉卻是七巨頭中跌最慘的。
Morgan Stanley 的 Adam Jonas 把特斯拉形容為「完全被前置定價」的股票，維持中性評等、目標價 417 美元。翻成白話就是：現在的股價已經先把 Robotaxi 和 Optimus 的成功算進去了，沒有實際部署，就沒有新的上漲理由。
而實際部署的進度已經落後，Robotaxi 目前在奧斯汀、灣區、達拉斯、休士頓、邁阿密、奧蘭多與坦帕七個都會區營運，原訂上半年七城的名單裡，鳳凰城與拉斯維加斯還沒到位。Optimus 人形機器人原本規劃七月底或八月開始小量產，馬斯克先打了預防針，說單機約一萬個獨特零件、初期產速會極慢，而到七月中為止那條產線還沒開動。
光譜另一端則是 Wedbush 的 Dan Ives，他預期 Robotaxi 將擴張到 30 個以上城市，喊出特斯拉市值上看 2 兆至 3 兆美元，但這個目標明白掛著條件：Optimus 商業化必須在 2026 年底前落地。
今晚該盯的三個數字
今晚要驗證的其實是 2026 年全球大型科技公司砸下約 7,000 億至 7,250 億美元的 AI 資本支出，有沒有開始變成錢。Alphabet 的資本支出規模自 2023 年以來已經膨脹超過五倍。
- Alphabet 資本支出指引: 1,800 至 1,900 億美元的區間會不會再往上調，以及自由現金流的失血速度
- Google Cloud 增速: 市場預期年增約 65%，同時看 4,600 億美元積壓訂單的入帳節奏
- 特斯拉汽車毛利率: 不含碳權能否守住 18%，以及 Robotaxi 與 Optimus 的具體時間表
值得注意的是，市場的耐心正在被重新定價。花旗上週才喊出「美股七巨頭已死」，主張改押注橫跨六大產業的成長型公司，理由是當所有巨頭都在同條賽道上砸同樣的錢，超額報酬還存不存在？
常見問題
Alphabet 和特斯拉 2026 年第二季財報什麼時候公布？
兩家都在美東時間 7 月 22 日美股盤後公布，也就是臺灣時間 7 月 23 日凌晨，Intel 則排在 7 月 23 日盤後。選擇權市場對 Alphabet 押 5.4% 波動、特斯拉 5.91%、Intel 高達 12%。
為什麼這兩份財報被視為 AI 資本支出的壓力測試？
Alphabet 今年資本支出上看 1,900 億美元，但第一季自由現金流年減 47% 只剩 101 億美元。市場要確認這筆錢有沒有轉成 Google Cloud 與 Gemini 的實際營收，而不只是折舊費用。

title: Bitget 上線業界首個 TradFi Quanto 永續合約，首期標的 MINIMAX 支援最高 20 倍槓桿
summary:
Bitget 推出業界首個 TradFi Quanto 永續合約，首期標的 MINIMAXHKDUSDT 支援 […]

〈Bitget 上線業界首個 TradFi Quanto 永續合約，首期標的 MINIMAX 支援最高 20 倍槓桿〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。
full_text:
Bitget 推出業界首個 TradFi Quanto 永續合約，首期標的 MINIMAXHKDUSDT 支援最高 20 倍槓桿與全天候交易。該合約以港幣報價，但保證金與盈虧皆以 USDT 結算，無需換匯就能參與港股市場。此舉結合永續合約的靈活性與 Quanto 機制的匯率隔離優勢，降低跨市場交易成本。Bitget 在 TradFi 合約領域市占率已達 11.01%，排名第二，持續推動 UEX 架構連結加密與傳統金融。
（前情提要：Bitget TradFi 挑戰賽落幕｜實盤交易石油、白銀，顯現財富效應）
（背景補充：Bitget 上線業內首個跨資產統一帳戶，100 種美股代幣可作保證金）
（本文為廣編稿，由 Bitget 撰文、提供，不代表動區立場，亦非投資建議、購買或出售建議。詳見文末責任警示。）
Bitget，全球最大全景交易所（Universal Exchange，UEX）宣布正式上線 MINIMAX Quanto 永續合約 MINIMAXHKDUSDT，支援最高 20 倍槓桿與 24/7 全天候交易。作為業界首個 TradFi Quanto 永續合約，該產品讓用戶可直接使用 USDT 交易港股等非美元計價的海外股票相關資產，全程無須兌換外幣。
MINIMAXHKDUSDT 合約本身以港幣報價，但保證金存入與盈虧結算均以 USDT 完成。此設計可簡化跨市場交易流程，並有效降低外匯兌換與匯率波動帶來的額外風險，為加密貨幣用戶提供更便利的傳統金融市場參與方式。
TradFi 永續合約需求升溫，Bitget 市占率居業界第二
根據 TokenInsight 2026 年第二季報告，TradFi 永續合約已成為成長最快的交易賽道之一，月交易量從 1 月約 520 億美元，大幅成長至 6 月的 2,680 億美元，增幅達 5 倍。
在此背景下，Bitget 於 2026 年第二季的 TradFi 合約交易量約達 690 億美元，並以 11.01% 市占率位居業界第二，顯示用戶對加密原生平台上交易股票、指數與其他傳統金融資產相關合約的需求快速增加。
什麼是 Quanto 永續合約？
Quanto 永續合約是一種創新型衍生性商品，適合希望交易非美元計價資產的用戶，例如港股、日股或其他海外股票市場標的。
該產品結合兩大特色：
- 永續合約的交易彈性：無到期日，可依市場變化靈活調整部位
- Quanto 機制的匯率風險隔離：使用 USDT 作為保證金與盈虧結算資產，無須直接持有港幣、日圓等外幣
透過 Quanto 機制，用戶可在不進行外幣兌換的情況下，參與海外股票市場價格波動，降低換匯成本與匯率不確定性。
Bitget 持續推動 UEX，連結加密資產與傳統金融市場
MINIMAX Quanto 永續合約的推出，是 Bitget 推動 Universal Exchange（UEX） 架構的重要一步。透過將 TradFi 資產引入加密貨幣交易環境，Bitget 讓用戶能在同一平台中接觸更多元的資產類別，包括加密貨幣、代幣化股票、海外股票相關資產與衍生性商品。
隨著 TradFi 永續合約交易需求快速成長，Bitget 將持續拓展更多 Quanto 永續合約標的，進一步提升用戶跨市場交易彈性與資金使用效率。
更多資訊

https://www.bitget.cloud/zh-TC/futures/usdt/MINIMAXHKDUSDT
了解 Quanto 永續合約原理與交易優勢：
https://bitget.com/zh-CN/academy/quanto-perpetual-futures
或點這裡註冊 Bitget 享有 20% 手續費減免。
風險提示： 衍生性商品與槓桿交易具有高風險，可能造成本金損失。用戶應依自身風險承受能力審慎評估，並做好倉位與風險管理。本文僅供產品資訊參考，不構成任何投資建議。
關於 Bitget
Bitget 成立於 2018 年，是全球最大的全景交易所（UEX）。Bitget 交易所為 200 多個國家和地區的超過 1.2 億名用戶提供服務，致力於透過其首創的跟單功能以及各類交易解決方案、幫助用戶實現交易「智」變，同時幫助用戶即時了解比特幣、以太幣，和其他加密貨幣價格。Bitget Wallet 是一款領先的非託管加密貨幣錢包，支援 130 多個區塊鏈網路和數百萬種代幣。它支援多鏈交易、質押、支付，並提供直接存取 20,000 多個去中心化應用程式（DApp）的通道，同時全面整合高級兌換功能及市場洞察分析能力，成為一站式平台。
Bitget 透過策略合作夥伴關係持續推動加密貨幣採用，現為世界頂級足球聯賽西甲（LALIGA）在東亞、東南亞和拉丁美洲市場的官方加密貨幣合作夥伴。秉承全球影響力策略，Bitget 攜手聯合國兒童基金會（UNICEF），致力於 2027 年底為 110 萬人提供區塊鏈教育支援。在賽車運動領域，Bitget 攜手全球最令人興奮的錦標賽之一 MotoGP™，成為其獨家加密貨幣交易所合作夥伴。
關於 Bitget Wallet
Bitget Wallet 是全球領先的去中心化 Web3 錢包，服務超過 8,000 萬用戶。支援超過 130 條主流公鍊和數百萬種加密資產，提供一站式資產管理、交易、市場數據、DApp 瀏覽、理財與支付等功能。錢包聚合數百個去中心化交易平台和跨鏈橋，支援多鏈互動。Bitget Wallet 設立了 3 億美元用戶保護基金，以增強資產安全保障。

title: 挺不過砸盤醜聞！Movement Labs 聲請破產保護，Layer 2 新星黯然退場
summary:
Movement 區塊鏈開發商 Movement Labs 已向美國法院聲請第 11 章破產保護。在短短不到一年的時間裡，這個新星項目歷經了造市商倒貨醜聞、共同創辦人出走，以及戰略轉型失敗的多重打擊。

〈挺不過砸盤醜聞！Movement Labs 聲請破產保護，Layer 2 新星黯然退場〉這篇文章最早發佈於《區塊客》。
full_text:
曾被視為以太坊 Layer 2 新秀的 Movement，如今正式走向破產重整。 Movement 區塊鏈開發商 Movement Labs 已向美國法院聲請第 11 章破產保護。在短短不到一年的時間裡，這個新星項目歷經了造市商倒貨醜聞、共同創辦人出走，以及戰略轉型失敗的多重打擊。
根據法院文件，Movement Labs 已正式申請第 11 章破產保護，意味著公司將在法院監督下進行財務重整。這家在過去一年飽受高層內鬥、造市商砸盤爭議與轉型失敗折磨的加密貨幣項目，迎來了最新的重大挫敗。
文件顯示，Movement Labs 的債權人數量不到 1,000 名，目前帳上資產僅剩 10 萬至 50 萬美元，但負債卻超過 100 萬美元。
值得留意的是，Movement Labs 最大債權人正是今年 5 月才與公司分道揚鑣的共同創辦人 Rushi Manche，其他主要債權人還包含德拉瓦州稅務局與加密資產託管機構 Anchorage Digital 等實體。
從 Layer 2 新星到深陷危機
Movement 是建立在以太坊 Layer 2 上的區塊鏈，採用 Move 程式語言開發。 Move 最初由 Meta（前 Facebook）打造，Movement 則希望將 Move 智慧合約引入以太坊生態，同時透過 Layer 2 提供成本更低、速度更快的交易體驗。
然而，Movement 自 2024 年 12 月推出 MOVE 代幣後，就一路陷入爭議。
MOVE 上市隔日遭大量拋售
根據《CoinDesk》在今年 4 月的調查披露，Movement 高層當時正調查是否遭人設局誤導，簽下了一份將 MOVE 代幣流通供應量控制權，極度傾斜給單一交易對手的「造市商協議」。
外洩的內部文件證實，該合約允許造市商在代幣上市的第二天，就將高達 6,600 萬枚 MOVE 賣掉，成為引發幣價劇烈暴跌的元凶。
神秘中介公司成爭議焦點
整起事件的焦點，落在一家名為 Rentech 的中介公司。這家公司出現在與中國做市商 Web3Port 相關的合約中，但 CoinDesk 取得的文件顯示，Movement 高層事後才驚覺，基金會疑似誤認 Rentech 為 Web3Port 的附屬機構才簽署合約。
對此，Rentech 則全盤否認有任何不當行為或隱瞞欺騙。
幣安封鎖帳戶，Movement 啟動回購計畫
事件持續延燒後，影響也迅速擴大。全球最大加密貨幣交易所幣安（Binance）隨即以「涉及不當行為」為由，封鎖參與 MOVE 發行的相關做市帳戶。
另一方面，Movement 則宣布啟動 MOVE 代幣回購計畫，並委託外部調查公司 Groom Lake 針對該筆爭議交易展開調查，希望釐清事件責任。
在內外交迫下，Movement Labs 與共同創辦人 Rushi Manche 最終於去年 5 月正式分道揚鑣。
轉型跨境支付仍未挽回局勢
眼看 Layer2 業務陷入泥淖，團隊也曾試圖尋找新出路。
今年 6 月，與此次聲請破產的 MVMT Labs 屬不同法律主體的 Move Industries 宣布調整發展方向，不再專注於與其他以太坊 Layer 2 項目競爭，而是轉向跨境支付、國際匯款及穩定幣清算等金融應用。
公司表示，已取得美國、加拿大及歐盟的合規支付基礎設施，希望打造面向新興市場的支付服務。
Layer 2 競爭加劇，市場轉向實體金融應用
Movement 的轉型方向，也反映整個 Layer 2 市場的最新趨勢。
隨著 Layer 2 擴容方案競爭日益激烈，愈來愈多區塊鏈項目開始將重心轉向「實體資產（Real-World Finance）」應用，包括跨境支付、穩定幣結算、資產代幣化等領域，希望尋找比擴容更具商業價值的成長機會。
不過，對 Movement 而言，在代幣發行爭議、治理問題與市場信心受挫接連打擊下，這場策略轉型最終仍未能阻止公司走向破產重整。

title: 瞄準 10 億用戶大軍！Telegram  預告今夏推出非託管加密錢包
summary:
全球坐擁近 10 億用戶的通訊軟體巨頭 Telegram，準備在 Web3 領域投下震撼彈。創辦人暨執行長 Pavel Durov 周二宣布，Telegram 計劃在今年夏季向全體用戶正式推出非託管加密錢包。

〈瞄準 10 億用戶大軍！Telegram  預告今夏推出非託管加密錢包〉這篇文章最早發佈於《區塊客》。
full_text:
全球坐擁近 10 億用戶的通訊軟體巨頭 Telegram，準備在 Web3 領域投下震撼彈。創辦人暨執行長 Pavel Durov 周二宣布，Telegram 計劃在今年夏季向全體用戶正式推出非託管加密錢包。
Pavel Durov 在自家平台 Telegram 上表示，這項戰略將是「人類史上規模最大的非託管加密錢包（指用戶完全自行掌控私鑰與資產，不假手第三方的數位錢包）推廣行動」。
這項旨在降低大眾接觸加密貨幣門檻的計畫，其實早有跡可循。就在上個月， Pavel Durov 才剛對外揭露，The Open Network（TON）區塊鏈的原生代幣 Toncoin 將更名為「GRAM」。
為了加速擴張加密貨幣版圖， Telegram 更直接取代了 TON 基金會，親自擔任該生態系的主要管理者與最大驗證節點。
儘管 Pavel Durov 在周二的貼文中並未透露太多細節，但他拋出了一個極具吸引力的亮點，預告新功能將實現「即時且零手續費的加密貨幣交易」。
事實上，Telegram 目前已經內建了名為「Wallet」的加密錢包，允許用戶儲存和交易和數位資產。今年初的官方數據顯示，這項服務已累積超過 1.5 億名註冊用戶。
考量到 Telegram 在全球加密貨幣投資人中擁有壓倒性的市佔率與極高的用戶黏著度，華爾街與幣圈長期以來皆將這款通訊平台，視為帶領傳統大眾市場（Mass market）跨入 Web3 領域的終極入口。
回顧過往，Telegram 的區塊鏈拓荒之路並非一帆風順。早在 2018 年，公司就首度啟動了 TON 專案，卻在隨後幾年捲入與美國證管會（SEC）的法律纏訟。當時 SEC 認定 GRAM 代幣發行違反了證券法，迫使 Telegram 全面暫停代幣銷售，甚至宣告放棄該項目。
如今歷經蟄伏後強勢回歸，不僅展現了 Telegram 深耕幣圈的決心，更企圖藉由龐大的社群基底，重新定義全球加密貨幣支付的版圖。

title: 「英國微策略」翻車！Satsuma 遭股東逼宮：被迫清倉 668 枚比特幣、宣告下市
summary:
英國上市公司 Satsuma Technology 周一宣布，股東以壓倒性票數推翻董事會多數反對意見，決議將清算公司持有的全部 668 枚比特幣，並撤銷倫敦證券交易所上市資格、終止公司營運，成為自「數位資產儲備（DAT）」風潮降溫以來，又一家宣告退場的企業。

〈「英國微策略」翻車！Satsuma 遭股東逼宮：被迫清倉 668 枚比特幣、宣告下市〉這篇文章最早發佈於《區塊客》。
full_text:
華爾街早前掀起的「企業囤幣熱潮」，如今在英國踢到了大鐵板。英國上市公司 Satsuma Technology 周一宣布，股東以壓倒性票數推翻董事會多數反對意見，決議將清算公司持有的全部 668 枚比特幣，並撤銷倫敦證券交易所上市資格，成為自「數位資產儲備（DAT）」風潮降溫以來，又一家宣告退場的企業。
Satsuma 的前身是一家名為 TAO Alpha 的小型 AI 新創。 2025 年 8 月，公司大動作轉型，不僅更換招牌，更重金挖角擁有逾 70 萬 YouTube 訂閱數的美國知名比特幣評論家 Mark Moss 出任「首席比特幣策略長」，他向來以指導機構如何將比特幣作為企業儲備資產而聞名幣圈。
轉型當月，Satsuma 氣勢如虹，透過發行可轉債狂吸 1.636 億英鎊（約 2.18 億美元）。這輪融資由 ParaFi Capital 領投，Pantera Capital 、數位貨幣集團（DCG）及知名交易所 Kraken 皆共襄盛舉。其中，部分投資人更直接掏出 1,097 枚比特幣，取代了約 9,700 萬美元的現金出資。
2025 年 6 月，Satsuma 股價攀上每股 14 英鎊的巔峰，市值直逼 6,600 萬英鎊。隨後，比特幣在同年 10 月狂飆至 12.6 萬美元歷史天價。然而好景不常，隨之而來的是長達數月的暴跌，「加密寒冬」來襲不僅重創幣市，也將 Satsuma 的股價拖入深淵。
到了 12 月，Satsuma 的財務防線瀕臨破口，被迫變賣資產求生。公司拋售了 579 枚比特幣，套現 4,000 萬英鎊，只為了湊足現金，償還那些年底不願將債權轉換為股票的債券投資人。
高層爆離職潮，大股東鳴槍逼宮
2026 年初，Satsuma 公司高層爆發出走潮。財務長（CFO）於 2 月黯然離職，執行長（CEO）也隨即在 3 月請辭。到了 4 月，Satsuma 股價相較於 2025 年 6 月的高峰已狂瀉逾 99%，跌至不足一便士。
也就在此時，持股約 6.7% 的 Pantera Capital 開始公開要求公司全面清算比特幣，原因是 Satsuma 當時的市值已遠低於資產負債表上持有比特幣的價值，意味著投資人直接持有比特幣，反而比持有公司股票更具價值。於是，代表逾 20% 發行股本的股東陣線，正式將清算比特幣資產的決議放上談判桌。
這項提案讓董事會徹底撕裂。 6 名董事中，有 4 名堅決反對，主張 Satsuma 仍是市場上具備可行性的比特幣上市投資工具；僅有 2 名董事倒戈支持股東。最終，股東大軍以懸殊的票數差距，強勢推翻了多數董事的決議。
回收資金不到一半，普通股東恐拿回更少
Satsuma 將透過英國常見的 B Share Scheme（B 股分配機制），把出售資產所得返還股東。
扣除約 270 萬英鎊的法律費用、資遣費、下市成本及保險等終止支出後，公司預估可返還 2,680 萬至 3,000 萬英鎊；若加上去年 12 月出售比特幣取得的 4,000 萬英鎊，公司累計可回收資金約 6,600 萬至 7,000 萬英鎊。
然而，相較於當初募得的 1.636 億英鎊，實際回收金額不到一半。此外，由於可轉債持有人在清算時享有比普通股股東更高的受償順位，因此普通股股東最終實際可分配的金額，很可能還會低於上述數字。
截至目前，Satsuma 仍是英國上市企業中的第二大比特幣儲備公司，持有 668 枚比特幣。排名第一的是 The Smarter Web Company，目前持有 2,878 枚比特幣，公司尚未透露任何清算比特幣資產的計畫。
根據規劃，英國高等法院將於 2026 年 8 月與 9 月審理資本返還方案；公司預計 9 月中旬完成下市，股東款項則可望於 9 月底前完成發放。

title: PC Harper killers' potential early release is an 'insult', says his mother
summary: PC Harper, 28, sustained fatal injuries while responding to a quad bike theft in Berkshire in 2019.
full_text:
PC Harper killers may be eligible for early release
- Published
The mother of police officer Andrew Harper has said it feels like an "insult" that two of her son's killers may be eligible for early release from prison.
PC Harper was 28 when he sustained fatal injuries while responding to a quad bike theft in Sulhamstead, Berkshire, in August 2019.
He died after getting caught in a strap attached to the back of a car and dragged down a country road as three teenage suspects fled the scene of the burglary.
Jessie Cole and Albert Bowers, who were passengers in the car and both 17 at the time, were handed 13 years in custody for manslaughter after a trial at the Old Bailey in 2020.
Both men might be eligible to be released from prison halfway through their sentences, the Ministry of Justice (MoJ) has confirmed.
Under the new Sentencing Act, due to come into force in September, some 6,000 criminals are set to be released under the early prison release scheme.
The government has so far failed to rule out whether killers, rapists and paedophiles will be exempt from the scheme.
The driver of the vehicle which caused PC Harper's death, Henry Long, received a 16-year sentence, and will not be eligible for the scheme.
Speaking to The Telegraph, external, PC Harper's mother Debbie Adlam said she had received a letter from the MoJ confirming their sentences might be reduced.
She said: "It makes me feel sick. Andrew's life doesn't get to come back. It feels like a slap in the face and an insult."
She added that "people are getting a free pass for crime" in the UK.
An MoJ spokesperson said: "This was a horrific crime, and our deepest sympathies are with PC Andrew Harper's family and friends.
"In 2024, the country was facing a prison crisis and a total breakdown of law and order, with judges ordered to stop jailing dangerous criminals.
"This government is committed to public safety: we are building prison places at the fastest rate since the Victorian era, and taking the difficult decisions needed to lock up the most dangerous offenders."
The government has insisted the Act will not see early releases for offenders deemed "the most dangerous", including those on extended determinate or life sentences.
The Police Federation of England & Wales responded to The Telegraph story on X, calling the early release policy "disgusting".
Deputy national chairman Brian Booth said: "Police officers from across the country stood side by side to honour Andrew Harper at his funeral.
"They and every serving officer will be utterly sickened at the prospect of Bowers and Cole being back on the streets so soon."
PC Harper, from Wallingford, Oxfordshire, responded to the quad bike call just hours after he had been due to clock off and begin his honeymoon with wife Lissie Harper.
After her husband's death, she campaigned for legal changes to see harsher sentences for the manslaughter of emergency workers on duty.
Harper's Law was among the new measures in the Police, Crime, Sentencing and Courts Act, external.
The move extends mandatory life sentences to anyone who commits the manslaughter of an emergency worker on duty including police, prison officers, firefighters and paramedics.
It is not retrospective, meaning PC Harper's killers cannot have their sentences extended.
'Smirking lowlifes'
New Justice Secretary Alex Norris has been urged to reconsider the early release scheme after being appointed by Andy Burnham on Monday.
Asked about reports that the prime minister could be working on exempting rapists and child groomers from the scheme, his spokesman said: "The government's fully focused on keeping the public safe.
"We've got no option but to take decisive action to fix the crisis in our prisons. I'm not going to get into speculation over possible policy changes.
"Of course, the prime minister will take decisions on all manner of policy areas in the future, including how we get justice for victims."
Aileen O'Connor, chair of Thames Valley Police Federation, said: "The killers of PC Andrew Harper should be kept where they belong... behind bars.
"Police across Thames Valley, and indeed the country, will be disgusted at the prospect of these smirking lowlifes being free to roam the streets.
"These killers have never shown any remorse for their horrific and deadly actions that night.
"Andrew's wife Lissie and his whole family are serving a life sentence. The least we can expect is that his killers serve their whole sentence, however poor it already is."
She added that the organisation would be communicating with the police minister, the home secretary and the prime minister.
"We will not stop. Andrew deserves nothing less," O'Connor said.
"What message does this send about the worth of a life of a police officer? The government and the parole board must reconsider any plans to release Andrew's killers early. And they must do it now. No ifs. No buts."
Cabinet minister Heidi Alexander said the early release scheme was necessary because the justice system had been on the brink of collapse when Labour came to power.
She told BBC Breakfast: "If we ran out of prison spaces, courts couldn't sentence and the police wouldn't have been able to arrest.
"No responsible government would have allowed us to get into that situation."
Meanwhile, new Defence Secretary Wes Streeting has insisted there was "no ill intent" behind apparent comments about the early release scheme, which were caught on camera.
He can be heard saying to Norris that "he wants to let them all out" - appearing to reference the government's plans for the early release of prisoners.

title: Ukrainian drones hit more sites of Russian online retailer Wildberries
summary: Logistics hubs belonging to Wildberries in the Krasnodar and Stavropol regions were struck overnight.
full_text:
Ukrainian drones hit more sites of Russian online retailer Wildberries
- Published
Ukrainian drones have hit warehouses belonging to Russia's biggest online retailer again, injuring 15 people, according to the company's founder and regional governors.
Logistics hubs run by Wildberries in two south-west cities were impacted by overnight attacks and workers were evacuated, the founder said.
It is the second time Ukraine has attacked the firm's facilities in four days, with warehouses in Tambov and Elektrostal hit on Saturday, killing eight people.
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said on Wednesday that Ukraine had hit logistics hubs in the Krasnodar and Stavropol regions "involved in providing the Russian army with drone components, navigation equipment and other gear".
Wildberries founder Tatyana Kim confirmed the attacks on two logistics centres in Krasnodar and Nevinnomyssk in the Stavropol region.
"There are no words to describe all the feelings and emotions caused by the attacks on ordinary people, on our employees, on us, who are simply doing our jobs," she wrote on Telegram. "But these situations demonstrate the most important thing: we must continue to do what we do for the benefit of people."
Five people were hurt in a warehouse complex on the outskirts of Nevinnomyssk, Governor Vladimir Vladimirov said, with everyone receiving outpatient treatment.
In Krasnodar, ten people were injured in an attack on a warehouse complex, with three in a serious condition, the region's governor Veniamin Kondratyev said.
Footage of both warehouses, verified by BBC Verify, shows fires in the aftermath of the attacks.
Video from Krasnodar captures an enormous column of black smoke rising from the structure as flames leap upwards. Nevinnomyssk footage shows people milling around outside as fireballs erupt in smoke streaming from the building.
Krasnodar's governor said the region was hit by a "massive attack last night", with drone debris also hitting the grounds of a company in Armavir and killing one employee. The city administration reported that an oil depot was struck, causing a fire.
Drone fragments also hit two apartment buildings in Krasnodar and two homes in the village of Dinskaya, Kondratyev said. There were no injuries.
Zelensky said Ukraine had struck an oil depot, as well as a tanker and four cargo ships of the Russian shadow fleet in the waters of the Sea of Azov and Black Sea.
Russia has been operating a "shadow fleet" to evade international sanctions imposed on its oil exports after its full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022.
The overnight strikes mark the second targeting of Wildberries' facilities in less than a week.
Serhii Kuzan, chairman of the Ukrainian Security and Cooperation Centre, has previously told BBC that Wildberries' website had been used by Russian volunteers to buy military equipment.
"The primary rationale for striking Wildberries' warehouses is to disrupt Russian logistics and the supply of dual-use goods, critical electronics, sanctioned goods and the like to the Russian army and Russian arms manufacturers," he said.
"The collateral damage from such strikes could also have a serious impact on the Russian economy, as well as a psychological effect on Russian society and, likely, on continued support for the war."
Additional reporting by Vitaly Shevchenko

title: Prince George poses in suit for new photo as he becomes a teenager
summary: It's a big year for the young prince, who will start secondary school at the elite Eton College in September.
full_text:
Prince George poses in suit for new photo as he becomes a teenager
- Published
A new photograph of Prince George has been issued by Kensington Palace to mark his 13th birthday.
The photo, showing a relaxed George standing with his hands in his pockets and wearing an open-necked white shirt and dark suit, was published on social media with a message which read "Happy 13th birthday, George!" alongside a party popper emoji.
The picture was taken at Kensington Palace last month straight after the Trooping the Colour ceremony, by photographer Matt Porteous.
George, the elder son of the Prince and Princess of Wales, is second in line to the throne.
It is a big year for Prince George, who as well as entering his teens, will also start secondary school in September.
The prince will follow in his father Prince William's footsteps and go to Eton College, an elite private school where entry usually begins at the age of 13.
Prince George's uncle, Prince Harry, and great uncle, Earl Spencer, also attended the elite boarding school for boys.
George will now become a boarder, at one of the Eton's 25 boarding houses. Each house have approximately 55 pupils, looked after by residential staff headed by a house master.
He previously studied at Lambrook School in Berkshire, alongside his sister Charlotte and brother Louis.
The young prince has been gradually introduced to a public role, including going with Prince William to help at a charity for the homeless at Christmas.
In June, he joined King Charles and other senior royals for the Trooping the Colour parade in London, to mark the sovereign's official birthday.
Earlier this month, he was seen with his parents at this year's Wimbledon tennis championships.

title: Military kit still failing women, troops say
summary: Servicewomen still face shortages of properly fitting kit, five years after a landmark report.
full_text:
Military kit still failing women, troops say
- Published
Women in the armed forces say they are still being issued kit that does not fit properly, five years after a landmark report warned they were at "greater risk of harm" from ill-fitting uniform and equipment.
The 2021 Atherton report said the Ministry of Defence should urgently roll out safer, more appropriate kit for female service personnel by the end of 2022.
Despite improvements, women have been telling the BBC some kit is still poorly fitting, with body armour failing to account for breasts, and shortages of smaller sizes resulting in "competition" among troops.
The Ministry of Defence (MOD) said it ensured everyone had access to the "best equipment they need to protect themselves in combat".
"I never felt that I was neat, tidy, presentable, or in the uniform that I was meant to be in," explains veteran Rhian Brown, who left the service in 2024.
"I never really felt that it protected me or entirely fulfilled the purpose that it was meant to."
Following the report by Dame Sarah Atherton, external, the Ministry of Defence brought out a new version of its latest body armour adapted for female troops in 2022.
It said it offered improved "fit, comfort and mobility while maintaining consistent ballistic protection standards".
Called the Virtus Scalable Tactical Vest, the body armour system has adjustable straps and smaller flat plates.
Brown, 26, who left the Army Reserve after seven years as an infantry platoon commander, wore it in training and on deployments.
She says the newer version was an improvement, feeling "tight and secure" and looking smarter, "but, ultimately, it still wasn't designed to fit me".
"Women are not flat, we have breasts and curves," Brown continues.
"The plates are flat, it doesn't fit, it is not flexible - fit isn't about vanity, it's about safety."
Brown, from Plymouth, said on one occasion the person issuing body armour told her "you're probably a small... but we don't have any smalls so here, take this medium".
It comes as the MoD paid for the supply of 2,000 sets of new curved body armour plates for women in the Ukrainian armed forces.
The UK government said it spent £4.5bn on military support to Ukraine last year.
It is understood the contract with NP Aerospace, based in Coventry, was in response to a specific operational need and sat outside the UK's wider equipment programmes, which go through their own testing and approval processes.
Seren White, who worked on the design of the new curved armour, said the plates had "been tested with the highest level of rigor".
For industry certification, she explained the plates needed to be tested 36 times - but the new curved plates have been shot almost 300 times.
Engineers said they were able to debunk some "myths", including that bullets can ricochet off the curve in the ballistic plate.
"Women today are wearing flat plates that have been designed for male torsos," explains Erin Grieve, from NP Aerospace.
"We are trying to address that women are not small men - they're shaped differently."
Grieve said the firm's own research concluded the curved plates provided women with more protection when compared with flat plates.
As it stands, this kit is not available for UK servicewomen.
The BBC spoke to a number of servicewomen who asked to remain anonymous.
One described her body armour as "definitely not female and definitely not good".
Another said there was "none or barely any" female-specific kit available to her and that the body armour did not account for "busty women".
Issues around kit and clothing have persisted.
Ofsted, which inspects MoD training establishment as well as schools, said in October 2025 that for the "fourth consecutive year" women and smaller recruits were being issued with ill-fitting kit and clothing, external.
Its report said: "This renders them at a disadvantage because they often do not appear as well turned out as their peers, or because ill-fitting equipment, such as webbing or rucksacks, prevents them from participating fully in training."
It added "ill-fitting kit poses a very serious risk" in combat situations.
Dr Mary Keeling, from the Centre for Evidence for the Armed Forces, said she was aware a rollout of new female kit and equipment, as well as availability, had been "inconsistent" since Atherton's report.
She said there had been "good steps in the right direction" but progress had been slow, adding faster changes were needed as the MoD aimed to increase the number of women joining the forces.
Keeling said it was likely improve challenges in recruitment "if women feel welcome by making sure that appropriate kit and equipment are available".
After the Atherton Inquiry, RAF veteran Stacey Denyer, who left the service in 2023, was one of a number of servicewomen who joined a ministerial roundtable to discuss putting its recommendations into practice.
"In the latter part of my career, they started doing women's fitting boots. It was amazing," she explains.
"We're not whinging for the sake of whinging - we're making noise because it is a massive safety issue."
Denyer, who is from Taunton in Somerset, added: "It absolutely needs to happen quickly and there is an aspiration for the armed forces to be 30% female by 2030.
"And, if they want to attract women, they need to start looking after them properly, and that starts with kit."
Fred Thomas, MP for Plymouth Moor View and a former Royal Marine officer, said it should be "an absolute priority" for the MoD to get body armour that fitted women at a time of heightened global instability.
Thomas was part of a Defence Select Committee hearing that reviewed the Atherton report in April, almost five years on from its publication.
He said he was aware of slow progress around improved kit but the services were "doing their best".
He added it was "unacceptable for some people to be better protected than others".
The MoD said new ballistic plates would be delivered in 2028 and would "be available in multiple sizes offering a better fit for all service personnel".
The BBC understands these plates will be flat and not curved.
The MoD added: "We are also developing the next generation of body armour through our Complex Geometry Body Armour Programme, which will enable the procurement of curved body armour plates."
It is understood these could begin to be delivered from 2029.

title: Nottingham attacks NHS trust faces manslaughter probe
summary: The hospital trust treated Valdo Calocane before he killed three people in the city in 2023.
full_text:
Nottingham attacks NHS trust faces manslaughter probe
- Published
The NHS trust that treated Nottingham attacks killer Valdo Calocane is being investigated for corporate manslaughter.
Calocane, who had been diagnosed with paranoid schizophrenia before he fatally attacked Barnaby Webber, Grace O'Malley-Kumar and Ian Coates in June 2023, was previously sectioned by Nottinghamshire Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust.
A public inquiry, which finished hearing evidence in May, was told he had been discharged in 2022 because he failed to turn up for appointments and the team had "lost" him.
The investigation into the trust is being carried out by Northumbria Police.
Nottinghamshire Police has been criticised over its history of interactions with Calocane and its handling of the response and investigation into the attacks.
A spokesperson for Nottinghamshire Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust said: "Northumbria Police, acting on behalf of Nottinghamshire Police, have begun an investigation into matters relating to the care and treatment of Valdo Calocane.
"We know how important the independent inquiry and police investigation are for the affected families, the survivors and our local communities.
"We will, of course, be co-operating fully with Northumbria Police, as we have with the Statutory Inquiry into these matters which is being chaired by Her Honour Deborah Taylor, and which will hear final submissions from all the parties involved later this year."
Nottinghamshire Healthcare was responsible for Calocane's care for two years before he was discharged in September 2022.
He was sectioned under the Mental Health Act four times during that two-year period and warned by a doctor he would end up killing somebody.
Following the attacks, he pleaded guilty to three counts of manslaughter, on the grounds of diminished responsibility, and to three counts of attempted murder.
Calocane is currently serving an indefinite hospital order in a high-security facility.
The Nottingham Inquiry, which heard evidence from doctors, nurses and other NHS staff, was told there had been numerous errors in Calocane's care and management.
He had a history of non-compliance with his medication and was known to become violent when he was unwell, it heard.
One of the key themes in the evidence about the killer's care under the Nottinghamshire trust was that his risk to others was not properly assessed or managed.
The trust had already been under the close scrutiny of the health and social care watchdog, the Care Quality Commission (CQC) before Calocane was under its care.
In October 2021, an email to staff said the trust had reached a point where services were "not safe", with concerns raised about staffing levels.
By then, Calocane had been sectioned three times.

title: 'We just need a bed': Baby with 'days to live' can't access lifesaving treatment
summary: Dylan and Catrin Green fear baby Macs has days to live and say he urgently needs a Berlin heart.
full_text:
'We just need a bed' - Baby with 'days to live' can't access lifesaving treatment
- Published
The parents of a three-month-old boy who they fear has just days to live say they're frustrated at being unable to access lifesaving treatment due to a lack of suitable hospital beds.
Dylan and Catrin Green, from Cardiff, said their "completely healthy baby" Macs started to struggle with his feeding, then caught a cold before later suffering two cardiac arrests.
He has been diagnosed with dilated cardiomyopathy, external - a condition which can lead to heart failure - and now has a "matter of days" on a machine which pumps his heart for him, Dylan said.
He urgently needs a Berlin heart , external- a device used to take over the function of a child's own heart until a donor heart becomes available.
His family said Macs has been stuck at a specialist unit in Bristol for weeks, where his condition has since deteriorated and was now in an induced coma, as the beds he needs were not available.
The two specialist hospitals in the UK where the Berlin heart can be fitted are Great Ormond Street Hospital in London and the Freeman Hospital in Newcastle.
"Seeing him in hospital is so difficult for us," Catrin told BBC-produced Newyddion S4C, external.
"It's really frustrating knowing there is a treatment available which could save his life."
She continued: "He could lead a full life with the Berlin heart. Although he would have to remain in hospital for an extended period, he would be able to learn to crawl... to walk.
"It would be really nice to reach that stage."
She said they were "desperate for the hospitals to find a bed for him".
"The clock is ticking for him, we just need a bed."
Figures from NHS Blood and Transplant (NHSBT) suggest fewer than five patients in Wales and England were currently using a Berlin heart - a device which can be used for several months prior to a transplant.
With only 2% of deceased organ donors in the UK being under 18, Macs' family was also eager to raise awareness about the importance of organ donation.
"It's not a nice subject to be discussing, but the more people who donate organs, they can help children like Macs lead a full and happy life," said Dylan.
The NHS Wales Joint Commissioning Committee (NWJCC) said it recognised the "difficult and stressful time this must be for Macs' parents, family and friends".
It said, while funding was available for patients who required highly specialised services, capacity was managed on a UK-wide basis, and access to treatment was determined through clinical assessment.
"We understand that the specialist teams involved in Macs' case remain focused on supporting him to ensure he receives the care and treatment he needs."

title: Five big names to look out for at Commonwealth Games
summary: These are the stars to look out for across the 10 sports at the 2026 Commonwealth Games in Glasgow.
full_text:
Five big names to look out for at Glasgow 2026
- Published
With 215 golds up for grabs at the Glasgow 2026 Commonwealth Games, highlighting just five medal hopefuls is no easy feat.
Scotland's largest city is set to welcome more than 3,000 athletes from 10 sports, all of whom have the ambition of leaving with a slab of metal resting on their chest.
For some, a podium-finish is paramount. The bare minimum. For others, competing at the Games is a win in itself.
Much has been made of the reduced programme, the city's readiness and the 'what next?' once Glasgow has passed on the hosting baton again, but for now, the attention - finally - is fully on the athletes.
Here, BBC Scotland highlights some of the biggest names set to compete in the upcoming Commonwealth Games.
- Is Glasgow ready for the Commonwealth Games - and does the city care? - Published5 days ago
 
- Can Wales find new Commonwealth legends in Glasgow? - Published2 days ago
 
- Keep up to date with the Commonwealth Games here - Published17 April 2024
 
Can record-breaking Kerr make more history?
We couldn't start with anyone else, could we?
Even before he walked the walk after talking the talk, new mile world-record holder Josh Kerr was the poster boy for his home Games.
The brazen - arguably gallus - boy from Edinburgh has won the hearts of many Scots, and athletics fans generally, in recent years for his no-nonsense, bullish approach on and off the track.
He set out his stall months ago, targeting the men's mile world record - which had stood for 27 years - at London's Diamond League on Saturday.
Kerr didn't just break it, he smashed it by nearly half a second, running a simply sublime three minutes 42.66 seconds.
The Scot now heads to his homeland for his second Games appearance, competing in the Commonwealth Mile in search of his first medal for Team Scotland.
The 28-year-old told BBC Scotland earlier this year that "gold in Scotland is what I grew up thinking about" and you'd be a brave soul to wager against him when he's in this mood.
Men's one mile final: Scotstoun Stadium on Saturday, 1 August.
Ten years on from Rio... Cox to swoop gold again?
It's hard to believe Kadeena Cox has not yet competed at a Commonwealth Games.
The para-cyclist, who won gold in athletics and cycling at the 2016 Paralympics in Rio, has missed the last two Commonwealth Games because of injury.
But the 35-year-old, who was a contestant on I'm A Celebrity... Get Me Out of Here in 2021 after winning Celebrity Masterchef earlier that year, will be hopeful of cooking up a storm at the ever-rowdy Sir Chris Hoy Velodrome for Team England.
In an expanded para-track cycling programme, Cox will compete in the C4-5 event with her sights set on another podium finish.
Cox made the watching world sit up and take notice 10 years ago in Brazil. Sure to be well-backed in Glasgow, it would be right on brand for the vivacious Cox to star in the Glasgow velodrome.
Women's C4-5 4000m individual pursuit final: Sir Chris Hoy Velodrome on Thursday, 30 July.
Can Le Clos become most decorated male in Games history?
When it comes to the Commonwealth Games, names don't get much bigger than Chad le Clos.
The South African swimmer is one medal away from becoming the most decorated male athlete in the Games' history. His current haul of 18 - seven gold, four silver and a further seven bronze - is deeply impressive.
A good number of them were collected in Glasgow 12 years ago when he equalled the legendary Ian Thorpe's record of seven medals in one Games.
At 34, Le Clos won't compete in as many races this time but is set to be on the blocks for the men's 50m and 100m butterfly events.
He won gold in the 100m butterfly here back in 2014 and also pocketed a bronze in the 50m - but he claimed a gold in that distance on the Gold Coast in 2018.
Any medal will secure the record for the man from Durban and Glasgow, where he produced such a remarkable show in 2014, is the perfect stage to make history.
Men's 50m butterfly final: Tollcross Swimming Centre on Wednesday, 29 July.
Men's 100m butterfly final: Tollcross Swimming Centre on Sunday, 26 July.
Teenage superstar Stowers to steal show?
This rising superstar is more a 'if you don't know, get to know' athlete.
Remember the name: Seine Stowers.
A junior Commonwealth Games champion, Stowers marked her 18th birthday earlier this year with four gold medals - breaking 12 records along the way - at the Universal Weightlifting Championship in her homeland of Samoa.
Competing in the women's 77kg - as she will in Glasgow - she lifted 142kg in the clean and jerk category as she established herself as one of Samoa's most exciting medal prospects for years.
Weightlifting runs in the family, too, with her sister, Feagaiga, a gold medal winner on the Gold Coast and a silver medallist in Birmingham four years ago.
Already, though, Seine appears to be taking centre stage.
American Olivia Reeves holds the world record at 77kg in both snatch (123kg) and clean and jerk (155kg), but with Stowers on the scene, who knows for how much longer?
Women's weightlifting (77kg) final: SEC Armadillo on Wednesday, 29 July.
More medals for 'Rhys 2.0' McClenaghan?
Rhys McClenaghan has done it all.
A European, World, Commonwealth and Olympic champion on the pommel horse, he is undeniably one of the sport's greats, but we've been warned to expect 'Rhys 2.0' in Glasgow.
Northern Ireland's gymnastics golden boy - who secured Ireland's first Olympic gymnastics medal with his gold in Paris two years ago - was forced into a spell on the sidelines last year with a shoulder injury, but he is ready to bring a new routine over to Glasgow.
"The Commonwealth Games is a good chance to show your work in progress. At the Olympic Games, you want to see your finished product," he said.
"It's going to be a work in progress, but hopefully one that is the best in the world too.
"Part of me is striving be like a younger Rhys, but the reality is I'm doing a completely new routine and the rule changes have pushed me into that direction - that's the Rhys 2.0 there."
McClenaghan won gold eight years ago, pipping England's Max Whitlock - who has had to withdraw from these Games with injury - before collecting silver in Birmingham four years ago.
He was the first gymnast to complete the Grand Slam and so arrives at these Games as one of Team NI's wise heads - despite only being 26 years old.
It's a frightening prospect for the rest of the field. Even more frightening is the fact he's rebooting for version 2.0.
Men's pommel horse final: The Arena on Monday, 27 July.

title: Where are Newcastle in bid to be the best by 2030?
summary: As the fifth anniversary of Newcastle's takeover approaches, BBC Sport assesses whether the project to be "the best" is still on track.
full_text:
Where are Newcastle in bid to be the best by 2030?
- Published
Three years, seven months and 21 days.
That is how long it took for Manchester City to win their first Premier League title following the club's takeover by the Abu Dhabi United Group in 2008.
Memories of such a relatively swift transformation were still fresh in the minds of top-flight executives after Newcastle United's Saudi-led buyout in 2021.
"There was quite a lot of fear in the other clubs because they thought it was going to be another Manchester City," a source said.
The reality proved a little different.
Newcastle may have gone on to end a 70-year wait for a major domestic trophy by lifting the EFL Cup in 2025.
Eddie Howe's side may have qualified for the Champions League in 2023 and 2025.
But the regulatory landscape has changed dramatically since Manchester City first set out to disrupt the established order, as football finance expert Kieran Maguire succinctly explained.
"The challenge for Newcastle United is in the era of PSR (profit and sustainability rules) and now SCR (squad-cost ratio), it is very much geared towards preserving the status quo," he said.
A huge revenue gap still to bridge
Newcastle, nonetheless, had big ambitions from the outset.
They may have been in deep relegation trouble at the time, but former owner Amanda Staveley made it clear in her opening round of interviews that the club's aim was to win the Premier League within a decade.
There was a concern elsewhere in the top flight that Newcastle could look to finance such a push within the rules by turbocharging revenues through lucrative sponsorship deals with Saudi companies.
As BBC Sport previously reported, an unnamed executive contacted the Premier League on behalf of his club and 10 others just a few days after the buyout.
He requested that notice was given of a vote to introduce a short-term ban on such related-party transactions.
This was the precursor to the rules on associated party transactions (APTs), which were introduced in December 2021.
Newcastle's income streams have still grown - from £140m in 2021 to £335.3m in 2025 - but they are lagging behind the Premier League's highest-earning clubs.
Newcastle may only be two places below sixth-placed Chelsea in the top-flight's revenue table, but the Blues still generated £155m more in the respective clubs' most recent set of financial accounts thanks to an aggressive trading model.
This is just one of the reasons why Chelsea have been able to agree a club-record £117m deal with Aston Villa for Morgan Rogers and hand the England forward a sizeable wage increase.
Three key players sold in less than a year
As the fifth anniversary of the takeover approaches in October, Newcastle clearly have work to do on and off the field.
Chairman Yasir Al-Rumayyan set out to be "number one" while chief executive David Hopkinson's aim was to be "in the debate about being the top club in the world" by 2030.
But Newcastle need the infrastructure to match.
An announcement is awaited on plans for a new state-of-the-art training ground after a site was identified in Woolsington near Newcastle Airport.
The club have stressed the importance of taking time to make the right decision when it comes to either expanding St James' Park or building a new stadium, which will be key to boosting revenue.
To consistently compete, however, there is little margin for error.
Newcastle needed to see more of an immediate return from a £100m-plus net spend last summer, for example, but defender Malick Thiaw has been the only unquestioned success.
The club are also counting the cost of a bruising 12th-placed finish last season after missing out on Europe.
Most pertinently, after breaching Uefa's financial sustainability regulations, Newcastle have entered into a three-year settlement with European football's governing body.
Raising funds through the sales of Anthony Gordon and Sandro Tonali to Barcelona and Tottenham Hotspur respectively was therefore crucial in order for the club to have the ability to reinvest this summer.
Three key players have now left in less than 12 months, though, which has weakened the side considerably, following Alexander Isak's painful £125m departure to Liverpool last summer.
Newcastle do not want to lose another big name in Bruno Guimaraes, but the captain's future is uncertain after he intimated he wished to join Arsenal.
Whatever happens, trading will remain a key part of the club's strategy in the coming years and there has been a shift in approach with incomings too.
Further reinforcements are sorely needed but all of the club's arrivals this summer - goalkeeper Ewen Jaouen, midfielder Sean Steur and winger Bazoumana Toure - have been aged 20 and under, and from the continent.
The trio have immense potential and, in the right hands, could flourish, but they will need time. It feels like the same could be said for the project as a whole right now.

title: Iran, Gulf hit as Hormuz, Bab al-Mandeb close: What’s the latest?
summary: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth tells US senators that the war has cost the US $37.5bn so far.
full_text:
Iran, Gulf hit as Hormuz, Bab al-Mandeb close: What’s the latest?
Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth tells US senators that the war has cost the US $37.5bn so far.
The conflict in the Middle East has widened as two oil tankers headed to Asia, carrying Saudi crude, turned around in the Red Sea on Tuesday after Yemen’s Houthis announced a naval blockade against Saudi Arabia.
The closure of the Bab al-Mandeb strait that connects the Red Sea to the Indian Ocean adds pressure on global trade routes, with ongoing disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz due to the ongoing US-Israel war on Iran.
Escalations continue, as the United States announced that it concluded its 11th round of attacks on Iran. Tehran retaliated, hitting US military targets in the Gulf.
Here is a recap of what happened on Tuesday night and Wednesday.
Where did the US attack Iran?
The US Central Command (CENTCOM) said that at 00:15 GMT on Wednesday, it concluded its latest round of strikes against Iran for the 11th consecutive night.
CENTCOM said it targeted Iranian military operations centres, maritime capabilities, aircraft hangars, drone storage facilities and military logistics infrastructure “to further degrade Iran’s ability to threaten commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz”.
The CENTCOM statement claimed that over the past three months, Iran had attacked more than 30 commercial vessels traversing the Strait.
The deputy governor of Iran’s southwestern Khuzestan province told the Fars news agency in Iran that US missile attacks targeted areas near the cities of Behbahan and Omidiyeh in the province on Wednesday.
The agency also reported that early on Wednesday, US forces attacked a military site on the outskirts of Tabriz in northwestern Iran. Al Jazeera’s Tohid Assidi reported from Iranian capital Tehran that explosions were heard in Tabriz.
Assidi additionally reported that air defences were activated in Tehran and that two blasts were heard in Bushehr.
Iran’s IRIB state broadcaster said that the deputy governor of Sistan and Baluchestan province had confirmed attacks on the southeastern cities of Chabahar and Konarak.
IRIB additionally reported, citing the deputy governor of Hamadan province, that US forces launched air attacks on Kabudarahang County in west-central Hamadan province in the latest round of attacks.
The broadcaster also reported that air attacks hit the Chavar and Abdanan regions in Iran’s western Ilam province and that US attacks hit the western Kurdistan province.
Where did Iran attack the Gulf?
Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) said on Wednesday that “the operation to punish the aggressor continues”, IRIB reported.
Kuwait: Iran’s military says it launched drones at US military facilities at Camp Doha in western Kuwait on Wednesday, Iran’s semi-official Tasnim news agency reported.
Jordan: Iran’s military said in a statement on Wednesday that it targeted Jordan’s Muwaffaq Salti Airbase in Azraq with drones, according to the Mehr News Agency. The statement said: “The army targeted the ‘housing and welfare buildings’ and ‘equipment warehouses’ of the terrorist US army at the Azraq base in Jordan with drones in the morning.”
Bahrain: The statement, cited by Mehr news agency, added that Iran targeted Bahrain’s Isa Airbase with drones.
“[Drones] also targeted the ‘large equipment warehouses and sheds’ and the ‘heavy aircraft maintenance and repair sheds’ of the child-killing and criminal US army at the Sheikh Isa Airbase in Bahrain,” the statement said.
Death, diplomacy and dollars
The US Department of Defense said in a statement on Wednesday that a third US soldier is believed to have been killed in action during an Iranian strike on Muwaffaq Salti Airbase in Jordan on July 17.
The department said the 28-year-old had previously been reported missing, but that the soldier’s status has now been updated to “Duty Status -Whereabouts Unknown, believed deceased”.
Two other soldiers were killed in the attack on the Jordan base. Another soldier was also killed in Iraq last week while attempting to detonate explosives on an Iranian drone. The latest death brings the total number of US soldiers killed to 18 since the war on Iran began on February 28.
US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said that Washington is open-minded on the war on Iran and willing to engage, negotiate and settle differences.
“If they’re serious, we’re serious. If they’re not, then we will do what’s necessary to protect our interests and also the interests of our allies,” Rubio said in a meeting with Southeast Asian counterparts in Manila.
Meanwhile in Washington, US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth told senators during a hearing that the war had cost the country’s military $37.5bn so far, urging them to approve an additional $67bn to replenish depleted missile supplies.

title: Mexico goalkeeper Guillermo Ochoa retires after 22-year career
summary: The 41-year-old, who played in six FIFA World Cups, announces he will retire from both club and country.
full_text:
Mexico goalkeeper Guillermo Ochoa retires after 22-year career
The 41-year-old, who played in six FIFA World Cups, announces he will retire from both club and country.
Guillermo Ochoa, widely considered among the greatest Mexican goalkeepers in history, has announced his retirement from professional football, bringing an end to a distinguished 22-year professional career.
Ochoa, who turned 41 last week, had previously stated that the 2026 FIFA World Cup would be his last tournament although speculation had swirled about whether he might sign with a new club to extend his playing days.
Recommended Stories
list of 3 items- list 1 of 3Morgan Rogers ‘so happy’ after joining Chelsea in record British deal
- list 2 of 3FIFA World Cup final draws record viewership in United States
- list 3 of 3Liverpool FC in talks to sell minority stake to Mittal-backed consortium
He put those rumours to rest on Tuesday.
“I gave it my all; I left everything on the field for my clubs and the national team, and today I hang up my gloves,” Ochoa posted on social media. “Being a goalkeeper means knowing you might wait 90 minutes for a single moment when everything depends on you. And when that moment arrives, you cannot hesitate.”
Ochoa was on Mexico’s roster for six World Cups – a number shared only by icons Cristiano Ronaldo and Lionel Messi. He served as Mexico’s starting goalkeeper in three of them: Brazil 2014, Russia 2018 and Qatar 2022.
Ochoa made his top-flight debut with Mexico City’s Club America in February 2004. He spent his first seven seasons there before transferring to French club Ajaccio in 2011, becoming the first Mexico-born goalkeeper to play in Europe. His European career also included stints with Malaga, Granada, Standard Liege, Salernitana, AVS Futebol and AEL Limassol, punctuated by a three-year return to Club America from 2019 to 2022.
“I never imagined how far a dream could take me. Today, I can only look back with pride and say: Thank you,” Ochoa wrote. “I take with me the affection of millions and the peace of mind that comes with knowing I gave everything for Mexico.”
Although he served primarily as a backup to Raul Rangel in the recent World Cup in North America, manager Javier Aguirre brought Ochoa on for the final 13 minutes against Czechia in Mexico’s last group-stage match. After the final whistle, an emotional Ochoa kissed the goalposts at Azteca Stadium – the venue where his career began – before kneeling to accept an embrace from his teammates. Long after the stands had cleared, Ochoa walked out to the centre circle one last time to take in his final farewell.
At the club level, Ochoa captured a league title with Club America during the 2005 Clausura tournament and won the Belgian Cup with Standard Liege. On the international stage, he led Mexico to six CONCACAF Gold Cup titles and earned a bronze medal at the Tokyo 2020 Olympics.

summary: The 23-year-old Rogers, one of the Premier League's top attacking talents, has signed a contract until 2033.
full_text:
Chelsea signs Morgan Rogers from Aston Villa in record British deal
The 23-year-old Rogers, established as one of the Premier League’s top attacking talents, has signed a contract with the London team until 2033.
The England World Cup forward Morgan Rogers has completed his British transfer record move from Aston Villa to Premier League rivals Chelsea.
No fee was officially disclosed, but media reports on Tuesday said it is worth 117 million pounds ($156.5m), which surpasses England teammate Elliot Anderson’s 116 million pounds ($155m) switch from Nottingham Forest to Manchester City earlier this month.

The all-time record Premier League transfer is still Sweden striker Alexander Isak’s 125 million pounds ($167m) move from Newcastle to Liverpool last year.
The 23-year-old Rogers, established as one of the Premier League’s top attacking talents, has signed a contract with the London team until 2033.
“I’m so excited,” he told the club’s website. “For me, Chelsea are the biggest club in London and a club I’ve always admired since I was a kid.
“I’m really excited about the project with the new manager, the players we’ve got and where the club is heading. That’s why I’m here, and I can’t wait to get started.”
Rogers is the third major off-season signing by new Chelsea manager Xabi Alonso, following wing backs Marco Palestra and Geovany Quenda.
Rogers was part of the England team that finished third, beating France, at the World Cup last week. They had lost to Argentina 2-1 in their semifinal.
He scored 21 goals in 85 Premier League appearances for Villa, and last season helped guide the club to a top-four finish and to the Europa League title.
Rogers joined Villa from Middlesbrough in February 2024 for a reported fee of 8 million pounds (about $10.5m).
He made his England debut in November 2024 and has now won 22 caps for his country.
Chelsea’s previous record signing was Ecuador midfielder Moises Caicedo, who joined from Brighton & Hove Albion for 115 million pounds (about $150m) in 2023.
Chelsea, who finished 10th in the Premier League last season, begin their league campaign away to Fulham on August 24.

summary: Italian Prime Minister Meloni says truth must be 'pursued to the very end' after death of Abderrahim Fakir in Bologna.
full_text:
Rabat demands answers after Moroccan man dies during arrest in Italy
Italian Prime Minister Meloni says truth must be ‘pursued to the very end’ after death of Abderrahim Fakir in Bologna.
Morocco is demanding that Italian authorities explain the death of one of the kingdom’s nationals during his arrest in Bologna, an event that has led to massive protests in the northern Italian city.
Morocco’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs said on Tuesday that it has asked Italy to “fully clarify” the details of 42-year-old Abderrahim Fakir’s death and determine responsibility.
Recommended Stories

- list 2 of 3Belgium bans imports from Israeli settlements in occupied Palestine
- list 3 of 3Europe should look to Africa for heatwave solutions
The ministry also called on Rome to take appropriate legal measures after Fakir was tackled to the ground by police and died.
Moreover, the Moroccan embassy in Italy said: “It is in the interest of everyone that full light be shed on this tragedy, by establishing the full circumstances of the events with rigour, impartiality and transparency.”
On the same day, Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni called for the “truth right to the end” in a post on X, calling his death “unacceptable”.
“It is imperative that any potential responsibilities are thoroughly investigated with the utmost rigour. The truth must be pursued to the very end, without prejudice and without leniency for anyone,” she said.
“But nothing can justify violence against law enforcement. Those who chose to use this incident as a pretext to set the city ablaze, assault officers, and sow violence – also endangering the safety of innocent bystanders completely unrelated to the unrest – were not seeking the truth: they were seeking confrontation,” Meloni added.
Protests and clashes
On Monday, demonstrations erupted in Bologna as residents condemned the police’s actions, which had led to the death of Fakir on Sunday.
According to Italian police, clashes between protesters and police forces broke out, leaving 54 officers injured. Italian news channel Sky TG24 reported that 11 protesters were also injured.
On the same day, prosecutors opened an inquiry into the death of Fakir, who had arrived in Italy at the age of five.
In a video taken by a resident, Fakir is seen calling for help as two policemen pressed him to the ground chest first for several minutes, leading to his death.
According to Italian media reports, police had been called to the scene by neighbours who had been concerned by Fakir’s erratic behaviour, with police officers having told the ambulance personnel that he was having a “psychiatric episode”.
Fakir’s niece said at a rally called by Bologna’s left-wing Mayor Matteo Lepore on Monday that they were calling for justice.
“We are not here to ask for hatred, we are not here to ask for revenge. We are here to ask for the truth,” said Yossra Fakir.
The incident has drawn parallels with United States police brutality and the killing of George Floyd in Minneapolis in 2020, who died after an officer knelt on his neck, cutting off his air supply.
